questions.description: 输出两个数七种运算的结果。
questions.code_template:
a = 15
b = 4
print(___, a - b, a * b, a / b, a // b, a % b, a ** 2)
questions.solution:
a = 15
b = 4
print(a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, a // b, a % b, a ** 2)

questions.description: 统计 1 到 10 的奇偶个数。
判断 17 是否为素数。
questions.code_template:
n = 17
is_prime = True
for d in range(2, n):
    if n % d == 0:
        is_prime = False
        break
print(___, "is prime:", is_prime)
questions.solution:
n = 17
is_prime = True
for d in range(2, n):
    if n % d == 0:
        is_prime = False
        break
print(n, "is prime:", is_prime)

questions.description: 输出 1 到 50 中同时被 3 和 5 整除的数。
用算术运算反转三位数。
questions.code_template:
n = 123
rev = 0
while n > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + n % 10
    n //= 10
print(___)
questions.solution:
n = 123
rev = 0
while n > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + n % 10
    n //= 10
print(rev)

questions.description: 判断 121 是否为回文数。
questions.code_template:
n = 121
rev = 0
temp = n
while temp > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + temp % 10
    temp //= 10
print(___, "palindrome:", n == rev)
questions.solution:
n = 121
rev = 0
temp = n
while temp > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + temp % 10
    temp //= 10
print(n, "palindrome:", n == rev)

questions.description: 统计数字的位数与各位和。
questions.code_template:
n = 12345
count = 0
total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    count += 1
    n //= 10
print("Digits:",___, "Sum:", total)
questions.solution:
n = 12345
count = 0
total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    count += 1
    n //= 10
print("Digits:", count, "Sum:", total)

questions.description: 求 4 和 6 的最小公倍数。
questions.code_template:
a, b = 4, 6
m, n = a, b
while n:
    m, n = n, m % n
print("lcm =",___)
questions.hints: 填空 gcd 后求 lcm。
questions.solution:
a, b = 4, 6
m, n = a, b
while n:
    m, n = n, m % n
print("lcm =", a * b // m)

questions.description: 输出摄氏到华氏的温度表。
questions.code_template:
print("C   F")
c = 0
while c <= 100:
    f = c * 9 / 5 + 32
    print(___)
    c += 20
questions.solution:
print("C   F")
c = 0
while c <= 100:
    f = c * 9 / 5 + 32
    print(f"{c:3d} {f:6.1f}")
    c += 20

questions.description: 用百分制分数输出等级。
猜数字并给出提示。
用 100 元找零计算最少张数。
questions.code_template:
price = 37
change = 100 - price
print("Change:", change)
for denom in [50, 20, 10, 5, 1]:
    count = change // denom
    change %= denom
    if count:
        print(___, "x", count)
questions.solution:
price = 37
change = 100 - price
print("Change:", change)
for denom in [50, 20, 10, 5, 1]:
    count = change // denom
    change %= denom
    if count:
        print(denom, "x", count)
